patterns.note: The site uses a full-width, alternating dark and light section layout to create strong visual breaks and guide the user through distinct content blocks.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif headings are used for key statements, creating a dramatic visual impact, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase navigation.
A high-contrast, limited color palette of deep black and off-white dominates the design, with a single vibrant green used exclusively for calls to action and interactive elements.

Sections reveal with a dramatic full-screen background color transition as they enter the viewport, often accompanied by content sliding or fading into place, creating a 'chapter-like' scroll experience.
The hero section features a dynamic, interactive image collage that appears to shift and reconfigure as the user scrolls or interacts, showcasing the site's focus on visual effects.

technique_notes: A smooth scrolling library (like Locomotive Scroll) is integrated with GSAP to orchestrate a highly interactive and fluid scroll experience, where the page background and content animate in unison.

Sections are designed to transition with full-screen background color changes and content reveals, using GSAP ScrollTrigger to detect viewport entry and animate elements (text, images, numbers) with staggered fades and slides.

The hero section incorporates a dynamic image collage that likely uses WebGL or Three.js to create an interactive, responsive visual effect, where individual images move and reorient within a defined frame.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text size) with smaller, regular-weight body copy and small, uppercase navigation elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and interactive cards, maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous, particularly in hero and feature sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing individual elements to breathe.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly interactive and animated scroll experience, where entire sections dramatically transition with full-screen background changes and dynamic content reveals. This creates a fluid, almost cinematic journey that emphasizes the site's focus on cutting-edge visual effects and animation.
